name: MMMU
description: Massive Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding evaluates expert-level visual reasoning across 11,500 questions from 30 academic subjects including art, business, science, medicine, and engineering. Questions are drawn from real college exams and require interpreting heterogeneous images: charts, diagrams, medical scans, photographs, and tables. MMMU-Pro (2024) adds 10-option variants and vision-only inputs.
typical_sota_score: ~70–80% standard; 50–65% on MMMU-Pro (dramatic 16.8–26.9% accuracy drops on Pro version)
reputation: Flagship multimodal benchmark; presented at CVPR 2024; human expert baseline ~80–85%; widely adopted by all major vision-language model evaluations; leaderboard on EvalAI with test-set submissions
notes: Manually curated from real college course materials ensuring genuine expert-level difficulty. MMMU-Pro (September 2024) reveals that original MMMU may overestimate capabilities: adding 10-option variants and vision-only inputs causes 16.8–26.9% accuracy drops. Human expert baseline ~80–85%. Presented at CVPR 2024. Top models still score <80% on Pro version.
